values: 一名使用诅咒和本能战斗的游侠，通过持续伤害使敌人接近死亡。
A Rogue who fights with instinct and curse, he deals continuous damage that slowly pushes his enemies toward death.
What do you need of me.
Hmm... There are no vermin nearby.
Is that a bird? Hmm... Oh, I didn't see anything.
Is this a reward for me...?
所有和翼打过交道的人都会得出同一个结论：翼或许称得上可爱，但绝对算不上聪明。
Anyone who has dealt with Shadewing would agree that he is an adorable dork.
翼的“主君”是一位亡灵，翼对她非常忠诚。他认为是主君将他转化为亡灵的行为拯救了自己，赋予自己新生。
Shadewing's mistress is a Graveborn—one he would die to protect. To him, his transformation into a Graveborn was a rebirth, a second life granted by her will.
有些时候，翼一整天都抬头望着天空。这让不少人担心他的颈椎会出问题。
Sometimes, Shadewing spends the entire day gazing up at the sky. Those around him can't help worrying about his neck.
尽管翼的双腿非常有力，但他无法倒挂在树枝上。
Shadewing has remarkably strong legs, but he can't hang upside down from a branch.
翼非常珍视自己的羽毛。如果他将一根羽毛送给你，要么说明他很喜欢你，要么就说明……你离死期不远了。
Shadewing holds his feathers dear. If he offers you one, it either shows his affection... or his murderous intent.
翼曾经是绿裔联盟的一员。但在以亡灵姿态重生后，他彻底失去了和族人的联络。
Shadewing used to be a Wilder, but he lost touch with his people after transforming into a Graveborn.
根据一位不知名人士透露，翼在进行监视任务的时候，曾经保持一动不动的状态长达三天半。他甚至连眼睛都不怎么眨。
According to an anonymous source, Shadewing once remained perfectly still for three and a half days during a surveillance mission. He barely even blinked.
翼生前和死后最统一的特点是：不喜欢自己的黑眼圈。
There is one thing Shadewing hates, both as a Wilder and a Graveborn: the dark circles under his eyes.
比起水浴，翼更喜欢沙浴。对他来说，羽毛被打湿意味着一旦危险降临，他将难以逃脱。
Shadewing prefers bathing in sand over water. It is because wet feathers would make escape impossible if danger were to strike.
翼有不轻的被害妄想症，曾经保护他的主君逃出并不存在的危险多达上百次。当然，这只是特殊情况。在更多的时候，翼的警觉都非常正确。
Shadewing is quite paranoid and often acts on false alarms. He's saved his mistress from make-believe trouble more than a hundred times. Nevertheless, his vigilance is spot-on most of the time.
It's raining outside... So wet and humid...
